consumerHandoffs.contract: Existing work_lock_for guard surrounds snapshot_revision/persist_snapshot. Acquire complete Today state/revisions/events/outbox plus configured task journal aliases and registry admission before that guard; raw helper bodies stay synchronous borrowed participants. task_calendar_set_sync calls today_mutate directly and must call today_mutate_in_transaction if it gains an outer lease.

recover_outbox, enqueue_record, set_record_status and drain_record event appends remain raw helpers used under Plan11 outer leases. When Plan12 adds their own entry admission, expose borrowed adapters for Plan11 consumers and switch these callers instead of reacquiring; independent background/provider commit stages need fresh requests retaining original parent snapshots. No global safety claim over current unowned callers.

Today/task sync entry calls now admit internally. If web_actions adds outer shared admission use today_mutate_in_transaction and task_transition_in_transaction before any domain guard, with complete source/destination/Today/task/receipt/rekey set.
